description: Returns the current date and time in any IANA time zone, plus Unix seconds/milliseconds, ISO 8601, weekday and day-of-year. Use it whenever an agent needs to know 'now'. Use this when an agent needs to the current date/time in any time zone — agents have no clock. x402 price $0.0005/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
